snippet.title: World in the Abyss - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the World in the Abyss announcement trailer for this upcoming open-world survival crafting adventure game. The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss in World in the Abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all! World in the Abyss will be headed to PC Early Access on October 22, 2025.
